body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> JVC showcased its new multifunctional iPod docks 'RD-N1' during CES 2010, which is a one-piece table radio-style entertainment center with CD player, FM tuner and a clock radio.

The RD-N1 is an elegantly designed one-piece system with clean, simple, European-type styling, with a high quality black finish. It offers a top-mounted iPod dock, CD player and FM tuner, plus a front audio input for connecting other playback device.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
